A four-stop review of this business context.

Choose a business context above. These stops navigate the current view; they do not load or modify records.

  1. 01 / Financial positionCan you explain the amount?Select one financial stage and inspect its source allocations. Commitment, posted, unpaid and paid figures overlap; they are not separate purchases.

  4. 04 / Maintenance evidenceWhat proves the work is complete?Inspect the technician record, independent verification and source context. Payment or a normal reading alone does not prove completed maintenance.

Each stop uses the same selected management context. The separate dated cohort, document inbox and historical research are different evidence modes. This guide does not join their records or change your simulation.

Invoice source evidence.

Governed coding

A missing item/work-purpose rule goes to the finance policy owner. Vendor identity alone does not supply a cost bucket. A held requisition is separate from an invoice and is excluded from approved-PO coding coverage.

Management figures need a defined meaning.

One snapshot, separate grains and accountable decisions

The financial position reuses the same purchasing journal and integer-cent analytical projection as the detailed report. Owner queues count distinct held invoice documents. Coding holds count requisitions separately. Coding coverage uses only approved PO lines as its denominator; a 100% approved-line result does not mean every request has an approved mapping.

Recorded work is compared with its captured purchasing and maintenance command histories. Retained earlier-context work remains visible and does not complete a replacement scenario. Payment and normal readings alone do not prove completed maintenance.

Fictional timestamps do not establish business performance

The example includes four approved PO lines across three cost centers, a paid pump repair, posted unpaid filter cost, invoice receipt/price holds, one unresolved coding request and work awaiting independent verification. All records and outcomes are fictional. Source action and completion timestamps are displayed as evidence, not used to invent aging, trend, cycle-time improvement or savings metrics.

This browser showcase uses HTML, CSS and JavaScript. It is not a live ERP/SCADA connection, production access-control system, native Power BI report or invoice OCR service.
